t: Sheen mebarekin shehecheyanu al asiyyat hassukka
s: Sheen mebarekin shehecheyanu al asiyyat hassukka ubo b' seipim: haoseh sukka, ben leatzmo sheyyesheb bah hu atzmo bechag uben laacherim sheyyeshebu bah bechag — eno mebarek al asiyyato, dehaynu sheeno mebarek "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu laasot sukka" kemo shemmebarekim al asiyyat shear kol hammitzvot, lepi sheasiyyatah enah gemar hammitzva, sheiqqar hammitzva hu lesheb bah bechag. Abal "shehecheyanu" haya rauy lebarek bishat asiyya im oseh otah leatzmo, shehare hi mitzva habbaa mizzeman lizman. Veim oseh otah laacherim — haya rauy shebbaal hassukka sheyyesheb bah bechag yebarek "shehecheyanu" bishat asiyyatah, sheiqqar habberaka nitqena al hassimcha sheyyesh laadam min hammitzva sheenah tedira ubaa mizzeman lizman, veiqqar hassimcha hi lebaal hassukka velo lehaoseh hassukka. Abal en anu mebarekin kelal "shehecheyanu" bishat asiyya apillu im oseh sukka leatzmo, lepi sheanu somekin al birkat "shehecheyanu" sheomerim beqiddush hayyom shebbelel yom tob bishbil mitzvat qiddush hayyom shehi gam ken mitzva habbaa mizzeman lizman, uberaka achat ola lekan ulekan:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshemmeqaddesh qiddush hayyom betok hassukka, abal im belel yom tob qiddesh betok habbayit — eno yotze bebirkat "shehecheyanu" shetztzarik lebarek al mitzvat yeshibat hassukka bibraka zo sheomer babbayit, ulepikak kesheyyikkanes lassukka leekol seuda acheret mishshear seudot hechag — tzarik lebarek "shehecheyanu" achar birkat "lesheb bassukka", apillu en hassukka shello:
